g.text: Gemma net lines-of-code per month · branch phase2-acl-migrate · symlog scale

Source: `git log phase2-acl-migrate --numstat --no-merges`. bucketed by calendar month (256 buckets). code = .java/.js/.ts/.py/.R/.scala/.kt/.groovy/.sh/.sql/.vue. excludes target/, node_modules/, build/, dist/, *.min.js, lockfiles. y-axis symlog (linthresh=1000) so the renovation month doesn't crush historical bars. renovations marker at 2026-05-16.
